**Kelsey Mann** (born November 16, 1974) is an American film director and storyboard artist. He is best known for directing the [Pixar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pixar "Pixar") animated film _[Inside Out 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out_2 "Inside Out 2")_ (2024), which earned him an [Academy Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Awards "Academy Awards") nomination for the [Best Animated Feature](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Animated_Feature "Academy Award for Best Animated Feature").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-Inside_Out_2-1)
## Early life and education
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kelsey_Mann&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life and education")]
Mann graduated from [Burnsville High School](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burnsville_High_School "Burnsville High School") in 1993. He went on to attend [Northern Michigan University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_Michigan_University "Northern Michigan University"), where he earned a [Bachelor of Fine Arts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor_of_Fine_Arts "Bachelor of Fine Arts") illustration in 1998.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-NMU-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-3)
## Career
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kelsey_Mann&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]
Mann started his career at [Cartoon Network](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cartoon_Network "Cartoon Network"), where he worked as a storyboard artist on _[Duck Dodgers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duck_Dodgers_\(TV_series\) "Duck Dodgers \(TV series\)")_ , _[Megas XLR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Megas_XLR "Megas XLR")_ , _[My Gym Partner's a Monkey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Gym_Partner's_a_Monkey "My Gym Partner's a Monkey")_ , _[Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foster's_Home_for_Imaginary_Friends "Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends")_ , and _[Star Wars: The Clone Wars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_The_Clone_Wars "Star Wars: The Clone Wars")_ , before joining [Pixar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pixar "Pixar") in 2009,[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-4) where he started as a story supervisor for _[Monsters University](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monsters_University "Monsters University")_ , _[The Good Dinosaur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good_Dinosaur "The Good Dinosaur")_ (also co-wrote the story for the film), and _[Onward](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Onward_\(film\) "Onward \(film\)")_.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-6) He made his directorial debut with the short film _[Party Central](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Party_Central "Party Central")_ , which he also wrote, taking place shortly after _Monsters University_.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-7)
In September 2022, during the [D23 Expo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D23_Expo "D23 Expo") announcement, Mann was announced to direct the feature film _[Inside Out 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out_2 "Inside Out 2")_ , which serves as the sequel to the 2015 film _[Inside Out](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inside_Out "Inside Out")_ , taking over for [Pete Docter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pete_Docter "Pete Docter"), who is instead the executive producer of the film, which was released on June 14, 2024.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-NMU-2)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-Inside_Out_2-1)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-9) In 2025, for _Inside Out 2_ , Mann received an [Academy Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Awards "Academy Awards") nomination for the [Best Animated Feature](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Animated_Feature "Academy Award for Best Animated Feature").[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-10)
In October 2026, it was announced that Mann had signed with [United Talent Agency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Talent_Agency "United Talent Agency") (UTA), having left Pixar to focus his career as an independent director and creator.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelsey_Mann#cite_note-11)
